response.memory: Dakota, who lives in my dorm, has fever, chills and cough and is also waiting on a flu test; they think it's the same bug going around Stern. I stayed a seat away and told them to rest and warn the dorm. I'll keep masking and stay home after my test.

messages.text: Heads up: at Vaden getting tested after Teagan's positive. Dakota from our dorm is here too with fever, chills, cough, waiting on a flu test. Stay masked and keep your distance in the dorm. I'll share my result when I get it.
